Name: Mickey's Gems
Author: venajiro
Description:
Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to change the sprites for a few minerals in the game in order to make them more realistic without swaying too far from the original style. All sprites are configurable via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. I made this a while ago as a part of a larger assortment of sprite changes but until I decide to get really stuck back into sprite art, I've decided to just release a few minerals on their own.


[b][center]REQUIRED:[/center][/b][center][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[b]RECOMMENDED:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/center]
